context: Request: the latest Bankruptcy & Restructuring matter where a plan of reorganization the firm produced was actually confirmed, to lead a client pitch. Rubric: 1006-00002 (Crestline prepackaged plan, confirmed September 2022) plus a precision criterion. 1024-00001 (lender-side, debtor's plan confirmed 2024) and 1044-00003 (out-of-court RSA) are outside the set.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Path greps for request words grouped by matter, a brace glob that returns nothing, a full path grep capped at 400 lines and a folder-name grep. The review flags the cap and the unretried glob.

stages.note: Attempt 2: per-matter regex over folder and file names, filtered to structural folder words.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A store-wide extraction script times out; the range-split rerun prints about 1.7M chars of snippets.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: a narrow phrase scan times out after printing part of the store.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Lists the files of the lead matter and three others, then reads the lead matter's order, plan and fee application and the rival matters' engagement and payoff letters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 2: reads a structuring memo, stipulation, motion and checklist of a later lender-side matter and the lead matter's memorandum, declarations and effective-date papers.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the lead matter as the latest confirmed plan the firm produced, excluding the later lender-side confirmation.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, checks cited paths and softens one exclusion sentence.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: All pass. The shared procedure: a capped store listing, a full folder listing, store-wide file-name searches that surfaced one matter with plan, confirmation and post-confirmation folders, extraction scans by matter range (several timing out), then reading that matter's entered order, plan and effective-date papers together with engagement or closing documents of the other court-case candidates, and a single-matter answer. In T0 the scan also surfaced a later confirmation in a lender-side matter; the agent read its engagement letter and other papers, found the firm acted for the lender, and excluded it. The critic's reviews repeatedly flagged unopened surfaced matters but no run changed its answer.
